title: Block Blast: Board Sweeper
description: "Just one more piece" — snap wild polyominoes into an 8x8 grid and detonate multi-line combos that scratch every perfectionist itch.
controls: Drag shapes from the tray onto the 8x8 board. Fill complete rows or columns to blast them clear and chain combos.

zh-CN.title: 方块爆破：清屏狂魔
zh-CN.description: 「再放一块我就睡」——8×8 棋盘上的极致解压连消！把奇形怪状的彩块严丝合缝塞进空位，多行多列同时引爆那一秒，强迫症直接原地升天。
zh-CN.controls: 拖住底部方块放进棋盘，填满任意一行或一列即刻清屏爆破，连续消除触发暴击高分！
